dishes.name: Weißwurst
dishes.desc: Pale veal and pork sausage simmered in water, eaten with sweet mustard, usually before noon. The best-known Munich dish.

dishes.name: Bavarian pretzel
dishes.desc: Large soft pretzel with a dark crust and coarse salt. Sold in bakeries and beer gardens throughout the city.

dishes.name: Schweinshaxe
dishes.desc: Roasted pork knuckle with crackling, served with dumplings and cabbage. The centrepiece of beer-hall menus.

dishes.name: Obatzda
dishes.desc: Cheese spread made from ripe Camembert, butter, paprika and onions, eaten with pretzels in beer gardens.

dishes.name: Leberkäse
dishes.desc: Baked loaf of finely minced meat, served hot in thick slices in a roll with mustard. A butcher-counter classic.

dishes.name: Steckerlfisch
dishes.desc: Whole mackerel or trout grilled over charcoal on a stick. Beer-garden food that Munich popularised.
